intro: Enchanted Gaea Seeds are specially prepared botanical seeds meant to bring revitalization to the ravaged landscapes of Kalimdor. Empowered through druidic magic and gathered at Sun Rock Retreat, they are planted directly into the ash-choked soil of the Charred Vale to counteract devastation and rekindle natural growth.

p: The Enchanted Gaea Seeds represent the Horde's druidic efforts to mend the deep scars left across Stonetalon Mountains. After raw Gaea Seeds are gathered and ritually enchanted by Tammra Windfield at Sun Rock Retreat, they carry sufficient resilience to overcome pervasive corruption and elemental blight. When pressed into the fertile dirt mounds that still survive beneath the soot of the Charred Vale, these seeds take root against the harsh conditions, anchoring new life in a landscape dominated by hostile fire elementals and invasive harpies.

The goal of planting these enchanted seeds extends beyond simple gardening; it is an active effort to turn the tide in the struggle for Stonetalon's future. The magic woven into the husks allows them to resist lingering corruption and establish a foothold for native flora. As they flourish, the restored vegetation is intended to soothe the agitated fire elementals, crowd out feral harpies, and counter the rampant deforestation driven by the Venture Company's relentless logging operations.
